key_insight: BayesPath improves whole-slide pathology reasoning by updating diagnostic beliefs while accounting for unreliable and correlated AI observations.
clinical_relevance: Its interpretable evidence trail and better-calibrated uncertainty could support pathology review and flag uncertain cases for pathologists.
method: Uses a training-free Scan–Look–Weigh–Decide workflow to guide region selection and stopping.
Updates candidate beliefs with reliability-aware Bayesian likelihoods.
Corrects model answer bias, discounts correlated observations, and models diagnostic confusions estimated without labels.
evidence_signal: Across five MultiPathQA slide-classification and slide-VQA tasks, BayesPath achieved 58.6% average accuracy versus 34.1% for the next-best training-free agent.
watch_item: Benchmark gains do not establish clinical readiness; prospective validation and safe deferral thresholds remain necessary.
paper_title: BayesPath: Reliability-Aware Bayesian Reasoning for Whole-Slide Pathology Agents
